_comment: One file per class. All classes share the studio05 base body; a class is an animation set plus how our moves map onto its clips. 'animations' is the GLB the clips are read from (same 102-joint rig as the body files), 'clip_marks' its timing marks. weapon_visible/weapon_scale/off_hand: what the hands hold for the look (the combat 'weapon' id keeps owning the stats). Advance (travel) distances live in the weapon's overrides in data/combat/weapons.json.
_weapon_families: Weapon items (catalog weapon_type) this class card may wear in its weapon slot, logic/profile.gd card_can_wear (Boss 2026-11-11) (placeholder: the catalog has only blade weapons; list the class weapon family here once its items exist).
_hair_options: Studio 2026-11-11 index.html hair buttons A, B, C, E, F, G (offered for every class); G = hair/hair_g.glb swapped onto the hair A file.
